# nxnative-4k-presets tools

Vendored unmodified from ninja8170/nxnative-4k-presets, commit
532cf2da64c0ad0ea5d83f875346f6f846aff338:
https://github.com/ninja8170/nxnative-4k-presets/tree/532cf2da64c0ad0ea5d83f875346f6f846aff338/tools

These are third-party BYML, SARC, RESTBL and zstd recipe tools. They contain
no game assets. The integration and version-gated recipes live under
dm/mac/graphics_preset.py and dm/mac/graphics_presets/.
